ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious New Service Creation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects creation of a new service via "sc" command or the powershell "new-service" cmdlet with suspicious binary paths

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\sc\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*create.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*binPath\\=.*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*New\\-Service.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-BinaryPathName.*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mshta.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*svchost.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dllhost.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/k.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/r.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\Start\\ Menu\\\\Programs\\\\Startup\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\TEMP\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp.*"))
